Hi Ethan,

I lead infra at Edgeware; we'd like to book an on-site technical walkthrough at Redwood HQ for our engineering leadership and platform team. Goal: 90-minute session to review integration patterns, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a short demo of a sample workload.

Proposed windows: Aug 25 (anytime between 10:00–15:00) or Aug 26 (morning). Our group is ~6 people (2 presenters, 4 observers).

A few logistics/questions up front:
- Can you confirm NDA/visitor agreement process (we prefer DocuSign before arrival)?
- Do presenters need special network access or can they use guest Wi‑Fi?
- Any AV constraints (we bring two laptops, one macbook, one linux)?
- Parking and building access details for external visitors?

If you can pencil something in, we can confirm attendees. Thanks — happy to be flexible on times.

Best,
Miriam Vos
Head of Infrastructure, Edgeware AI
M: +1 415‑555‑0127

Hi Miriam — great to hear from you, thanks for reaching out. We'd love to host you.

I can offer two slots that work on our side:
- Tue, Aug 25 at 10:30 AM PT (preferred)
- Wed, Aug 26 at 9:30 AM PT (backup)

Answers to your questions:
- NDA: we can send a visitor agreement via DocuSign and ask for signatures before arrival. Marissa (cc'd) will handle logistics and the DocuSign flow.
- Network: presenters should plan to use guest Wi‑Fi; we can provision a temporary VLAN if you need ssh access to internal test nets, but that requires advance request and security review.
- AV: rooms have HDMI and USB‑C (adapter available). If you need any special audio capture or external capture cards, let us know.
- Parking: we have a limited visitor permit system — Marissa will provide the code and pick‑up instructions.

Please confirm whether Aug 25 at 10:30 works and share a headcount + attendee names so we can prepare badges.

Cheers,
Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Miriam — welcome, great to have you on site. Logistics below for Aug 25, 10:30 AM slot (confirmed):

Room / access
- Room: Cedar 3 (2nd floor conference wing) — capacity 12, AV-ready.
- Please arrive at the main lobby 15 minutes early for badge pickup; security will verify IDs. We will assign an escort to guide you to Cedar 3.

AV / Recording
- Room has HDMI + USB‑C input, USB‑A power, and a tabletop conference mic.
- Recording is permitted for internal use; please let us know if the recording will be shared externally. Registered capture devices are allowed but must be surrendered to security for inspection on arrival if they connect to PCI/secure interfaces.

Network
- Guest Wi‑Fi credentials will be provided on arrival. If you need egress rules or registry access, open a request at least 48 hours in advance to allow security to provision temporary rules.

Parking / Directions
- Visitor permit code: RWD-5421 (enter at kiosk; valid for one vehicle per permit)
- Street parking is available nearby; the visitor lot fills early.

What we need from you by EOD Aug 20
- Full attendee list (first/last name, company, email) for badges and background checks
- Any special AV requests (capture card, dedicated HDMI splitter)
- Confirmation whether recording will be shared externally

Attachments/links
- Attached: redwood_visitor_agreement_2026.pdf (visitor agreement — please sign via DocuSign link below)
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/EDGE-4532/nda
- Visitor guide: https://redwood.app/docs/visitor-guide

If you want a whiteboard or dedicated breakout, Dev (cc'd) can set up an adjacent lab room. Looking forward to hosting you.
